map.由索赔频率与平均赔付额求期望损失 使用指南: Expected loss from claim frequency and average payout user guide
map.输入单位风险的索赔频率与平均赔付额，按 ECL = 频率 × 平均赔付额计算期望: Input claim frequency and average payout per unit risk; compute expected loss cost by ECL = frequency x average payout, for setting pure premium and assessing business-portfolio risk cost.
map.输入单位风险索赔频率与平均赔付额，求期望损失成本。: Input claim frequency and average payout per unit risk to find expected loss cost.
map.定价的纯保费基础：每标的期望赔款 = 出险率×案均。: Pure premium basis for pricing: expected claim per risk = loss frequency x average claim.
map.做业务线盈亏平衡的纯风险成本。: Pure risk cost for a business line's break-even.
map.：期望损失 = 0.05×20000 = 1000 元/标的一年。即纯风险成本约: : expected loss = 0.05 x 20000 = 1000 yuan per risk per year. That is, the pure risk cost is about 1000 yuan.
map.由一年生存概率求死亡力: Find force of mortality from one-year survival probability
map.由纯保费与附加费率求毛保费: Find gross premium from pure premium and loading rate
map.由终极赔款与已付比例估算未决赔款: Estimate outstanding claims from ultimate claims and paid ratio
map.这只是纯保费吗？: Is this only the pure premium?
map.是纯保费(风险成本)，尚未加费用、利润与安全边际；毛保费还要乘 (1+附加费率): It is the pure premium (risk cost), not yet adding expense, profit and safety margin; the gross premium also multiplies by (1+loading rate).
map.期望损失要不要加安全边际？: Should expected loss add a safety margin?
map.纯保费等于期望损失，但实际定价还要加风险边际（应对波动）和费用附加。直接用期望损: Pure premium equals expected loss, but actual pricing also adds risk margin (for fluctuation) and expense loading. Pricing directly by expected loss loses money in bad years; a multiple of standard deviation must be added.
